    pos = sorted([a, b, c])

    dist_ab = abs(pos[0] - pos[1])
    dist_bc = abs(pos[1] - pos[2])
    dist_ac = abs(pos[0] - pos[2])
    # Determine the maximum of these distances
    max_dist = max(dist_ab, dist_bc, dist_ac)
    # If the maximum distance is already greater than or equal to d, return 0
    if max_dist >= d:
        return 0
    # Otherwise, calculate the minimum duration needed to achieve the required distances
    else:
        # The minimum duration is half of the difference between the required distance and the current maximum distance
        return (d - max_dist + 1) // 2
